note: No active wipe signal. RETIRED 2026-08-10 — see below before re-arming.

retired.why: It never stopped firing. A cold client has no seen-marker, so it applied the wipe on first load: masters emptied, bhb_masters_desk_db_meta_v1 stamped with the 2026-08-05 timestamp and classCount 0. Clearing site data DELETES the seen-marker, so clearing re-triggered the wipe — which is why 'clear your browser', the advice staff were given, left devices worse than before. Combined with the cold-client fabrication (fixed in the same change), the emptied masters was refilled with freshly invented class ids, and the device then had every push refused as 'regenerated'.
retired.ifYouReArmThis: It is still a valid tool for forcing stale desks to drop after an id re-seed. Two things to know: (1) the signal now expires after MAX_WIPE_SIGNAL_AGE_DAYS in lib/tenantDataWipe.ts, so it cannot haunt new clients indefinitely; (2) set wipedAt to the moment of the re-seed, and retire it once devices have drained.
